rules.statement: A trial Judge should assess the oral evidence and bring his mind to bear on the facts relevant to the dispute and give reasons for his decision of the dispute as required by Section 187 of the Code.

rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 187 of the Civil Procedure Code
